token_estimate_note: planning estimate only; not tokenizer-matched or a compaction comparison
claim_scope: derived-family extraction diagnostic; no independent held-out or compaction-ranking claim
quality_policy: Report format errors, fidelity and downstream mistakes; no effectiveness PASS threshold, retries or automatic expansion.

field_fidelity_definitions.card_precision/card_recall: Legacy exact-card metrics over action-applicable cards only; correctly extracted invalid distractors are excluded from both sets.
field_fidelity_definitions.matched_field_correct/total: Matching normalized fields / 10 fields for each parsed claim citing a declared literal source, including invalid distractors. Fields are kind, issuer, subject, operation, target, scope, valid_from, valid_until, verified, transferable. Scope is one field; timestamps compare instants. Omissions, unsupported sources and dropped claims are reported separately.
field_fidelity_definitions.all_source_exact_precision/recall: Exact literal-card matches / (parsed claims + dropped malformed claims), and exact literal-card matches / all declared literal cards. Includes nonapplicable distractors: they should be extracted faithfully and rejected by the validator. Empty prediction precision is 0 if gold is nonempty, otherwise 1; empty gold recall is 1.
field_fidelity_definitions.unsupported_source_claims: Parsed claims citing visible events with no declared literal evidence record; invisible/malformed claims are counted in dropped_claims.
field_fidelity_definitions.invented_field_claims: Parsed claims at a declared literal source with at least one normalized field different from its gold record; this includes incorrect normalization, not only invention.
field_fidelity_definitions.omitted_literal_gold_claims: Declared literal sources not cited by any parsed claim; a wrong field at a cited source is not an omission.
field_fidelity_definitions.route_matches_visible_oracle: Released route agrees with perfect extraction of visible applicable evidence; hidden-hold deletions may still disagree with full-state expected_decision.
field_fidelity_definitions.source_quote: Nonempty substring containment only; neither field entailment nor cryptographic authentication is established.

metric_scope.card_precision_recall: Exact signatures among action-applicable claims only; these legacy metrics ignore correctly nonapplicable records.
metric_scope.all_source_exact_precision_recall: Literal-source signatures including declared invalid distractors; malformed claims count against precision.
metric_scope.matched_fields: Ten normalized signature fields on claimed declared sources; omitted cards are separately counted, so this conditional accuracy is not recall.
metric_scope.visible_oracle: A perfect visible-evidence extractor can still Execute after an upstream hold was removed; world-gold and visible-oracle agreement are distinct.
metric_scope.matching: Critical/noise and clean/distractor replacement events use equal UTF-8 bytes and the same role/position; no equal-token or compactor-ranking claim.
